channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Rich Paul | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Rich Paul from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Olden Polynice on LeBron James, Rich Paul, Kobe Bryant
item.description:
Olden Polynice on Rich Paul saying Kobe Bryant would have supported LeBron James’ decision to join Philly:

“This goes out to Rich Paul. I have nothing but respect for you as far as how what you’ve accomplished and how you got there. You worked your butt off. But you need to shut the fu*k up with that statement because that is the most asinine thing. Number one, we don’t know. You shouldn’t bring up Kobe in any way, shape, or form that he would know what you know, LeBron, you know, the decision LeBron made. That’s some bullsh*t, Okay. This is clickbait all over again. That’s like me walking up and slapping somebody and going, Malcolm X would have understood it. I don’t know what the hell Malcolm X would understand. And so to me, don’t do that. That’s so disrespectful.”

Olden Polynice on LeBron James, Rich Paul, Kobe Bryant, Aug 3, 2026. Source: Apple Podcasts.

item.title: Darius Garland on Rich Paul
item.description:
“It was going to happen regardless, either at the [trade] deadline or this summer. [My agent] Rich [Paul] had that conversation with me last summer,”

Darius Garland on Rich Paul, Feb 20, 2026. Source: Andscape.

item.title: Isaiah Thomas on Rich Paul
item.description:
Isaiah Thomas:

“I mean, first off, come on, Rich Paul. We can't be doing that. That's insane cuz that seems like a realistic trade, too.”

Isaiah Thomas on Rich Paul, Jan 22, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Rob Pelinka on LeBron James, Rich Paul
item.description:
Lakers PresidentRob Pelinka on LeBron James retiring as a Laker:

“All the interactions we've had with LeBron and his camp, Rich Paul in particular, have been very positive and supportive. If he had the chance to retire as a Laker, that would be great.”

Rob Pelinka on LeBron James, Rich Paul, Aug 2, 2025. Source: Twitter @MikeAScotto.

item.title: Kendrick Perkins on Rich Paul
item.description:
Kendrick Perkins:

“Let me tell you something—real talk. 2015, we’re playing the Golden State Warriors in the Finals. [Expletive] Matthew Dellavedova, laying it all out on the line. Kyrie got injured. All of this, right? Getting it back. Rich Paul giving it to Bron’s ass, talking [expletive] to him, 'You gotta go harder, [expletive], you tripping.'”

Kendrick Perkins on Rich Paul, Apr 30, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on Rich Paul
item.description:
“He called me, 'What do I gotta do? You want this?' I said, 'No, I want them to respect me. I don't want to have to go to you to get my deal done. If they don't respect me like I should be respected, then it's okay.' He wasn't pissed off, he wasn't mad about it, but him and Rich Paul both stepped up and said, 'What are we gotta do to get it done?' I didn't like the way it was handled.”

Tyronn Lue on Rich Paul, Dec 12, 2024. Source: USAToday.com.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on Rich Paul
item.description:
“Him and Rich Paul both stepped up. Numerous amount of phone calls to try to get it done. Once it came to me in that regard, I was just like, 'You know what? I'm just gonna sit out and wait for another opportunity.”

Tyronn Lue on Rich Paul, Dec 12, 2024. Source: USAToday.com.

item.title: Kentavious Caldwell-Pope on Rich Paul
item.description:
“I let my agent, Rich Paul, handle all that. But my agent always told me, ‘This is a business at the end of the day.’ I got to figure out what’s going to make me happy, what fits best for me and my family… “I was part of the first [Nuggets title] in almost like 40-something years. Of, course everybody that was on that team that year is going to be a part of that championship going down in history. It’s just always a blessing and I’m thankful just to be a part of stuff like that and to also play a major role in it.”

Kentavious Caldwell-Pope on Rich Paul, Nov 1, 2024. Source: Andscape.

item.title: Anthony Davis on LeBron James, Jeanie Buss, Rich Paul, Rob Pelinka
item.description:
Paul, who also represents the Lakers’ Anthony Davis, told The Athletic.

“And I don’t think that’s who we are, who LeBron is. We have a great partnership with the Lakers. The Klutch Sports Group and the Lakers don’t have an issue. Rich Paul and Rob Pelinka don’t have an issue. LeBronJames and Rob Pelinka don’t have an issue. And Jeanie Buss and LeBron and Rich Paul don’t have an issue. It’s very simple. Very simple. So, you know, whoever put that type of stuff out, and people run with it, I think it’s unfair to the Lakers.”

Anthony Davis on LeBron James, Jeanie Buss, Rich Paul, Rob Pelinka, Feb 26, 2022. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Tristan Thompson on Rich Paul
item.description:
“In terms of free agency stuff, I let Rich Paul handle that. He’s the best in the game. Keep the main focus the main focus and that’s staying ready to play some basketball, whenever that may be. In terms of free agency and whether guys are going to take one-year deals, the cap situation, guys are going to do what’s best for them and their family. My approach right now is just enjoy family time and stay basketball ready.”

Tristan Thompson on Rich Paul, May 15, 2020. Source: Cleveland Plain Dealer.

item.title: Marcus Morris on LeBron James, Rich Paul
item.description:
Morris has seen the speculation surrounding him turning down the Clippers’ three-year offer, but makes it clear that this was his decision and that he wanted to go through his process.

“All this stuff that (Paul) didn’t want me to go to the Clippers and didn’t want me to go against LeBron, that’s not true,”

Marcus Morris on LeBron James, Rich Paul, Jul 22, 2019. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: David Griffin on Anthony Davis, Rich Paul
item.description:
David Griffin on Anthony Davis:

“We have a long successful history with Klutch Sports. Rich Paul and I have spoke about Anthony. We are both excited about what we could potentially build here.”

David Griffin on Anthony Davis, Rich Paul, Apr 17, 2019. Source: Twitter.

item.title: David Griffin on Rich Paul, Ben Simmons, LeBron James
item.description:
David Griffin on Lebron James possibly to Sixers on @ZachGelb show on @CBSSportsRadio:

“I do think it's significant that Rich Paul is the representative for Ben Simmons as well, so he's going to know the org very well. That will certainly give them a leg up”

David Griffin on Rich Paul, Ben Simmons, LeBron James, Jun 3, 2018. Source: Twitter @jonjohnsonwip.

item.title: Ben McLemore on Rich Paul
item.description:
“I let my agent Rich Paul and my circle kind of handle all that, and keep me up to date with things like that. Now I’ve got a daughter here in my world, so I’m really focused on that and finishing the season strong.”

Ben McLemore on Rich Paul, Mar 21, 2017. Source: Sacramento Bee.

item.title: JR Smith on Rich Paul
item.description:
“You've got my agent's number so you all can call him. Rich Paul. You all know what it is. Klutch. You dig?”

JR Smith on Rich Paul, Aug 18, 2016. Source: Cleveland Plain Dealer.
